notablePrerequisites:
Skirsdag High Priest does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other untapped creatures.
A creature has died this turn.
description:
Activate Skirsdag High Priest by tapping it and two other creatures you control, creating a 5/5 Demon creature token.
The Demon enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
